entities.name: Boris Valábik
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Boris Valábik is a Slovak former professional ice hockey defenceman, retired police officer and currently a pundit, columnist, television presenter and television personality. Valábik was drafted in the first round, tenth overall, of the 2004 NHL Entry Draft by the Atlanta Thrashers and played 80 regular season games for the Thrashers.
